description_sq:
Objekti pozicionohet perballe "Dispanserise" shume prane Bulevardit Zogu i Pare dhe Bulevardit te ri. 
Objekti eshte projektuar nga studio "Atelier 4" ku do zhvillohen dy godina sherbimi dhe banimi ne 5 dhe 8 kate me 2 kate parkim nentoke. Aktualisht jane ne faze ndertimi.
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e katert, organizohet ne nje sip 69.47m2 ne nje ambient ndenje, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon. 
Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE IN FRONT OF THE DISPENSARY
description_en: The facility is positioned in front of the "Dispensary" very close to Zogu i Pare Boulevard and new Boulevard. The facility was designed by the "Atelier 4" studio, where two service and residential buildings will be developed on the 5th and 8th floors with 2 floors of underground parking. They are currently under construction. The apartment is located on the fourth floor, it is organized in a 69.47m2 plot in a living room, bedroom, bathroom and balcony. For more information, contact us.
